text.g1b8f8622f1: And He caused you to inherit
text.g2d441abf97: so that He may bring you out
text.g3fccfbca5f: and the women who give charity
text.g7581050d34: and a bearer of glad tidings
text.g7a76b728e9: We will let you overpower them
text.gcc61342c1d: lest should be moved with desire
text.ge6e9703039: and the men who give charity
text.gf6767713d6: you will be allowed to enjoy

spoken.g1fd214cc99: they would have certainly done it
spoken.g6b6ba8af34: and the women who guard it
spoken.ge646f758ef: and Allah will turn in Mercy
